visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up shot of reddish-brown tea being poured from a measuring cup into a clear plastic cup. A thick layer of frothy, orange-tinted foam forms at the surface. The background shows a clean, industrial stainless steel counter with blurred kitchen equipment. (2) A thick, creamy white milk foam is poured slowly over a light yellow liquid in a cup, creating a soft, cloud-like texture. The plastic cup features a minimalist black cartoon logo of a girl holding a drink. The lighting is bright and even. (3) An exterior shot shows a tea shop named 'MA MA TEA' with the Chinese name '紅茶媽媽' on a white and black sign. The storefront is a street-level commercial space with a digital menu and white tiled pillars. Motorbikes are parked on the sunny street outside. (4) A person's hands hold two large tea cups—one dark red and one light golden—towards the camera. The cups are filled with ice and have the shop's girl logo prominently displayed. The scene is shot outdoors in bright, natural daylight with a shallow depth of field. (5) A close-up shows a hand in a purple nitrile glove depressing the lever of a white tea dispenser. A stream of dark amber liquid flows into a cup below. Several similar dispensers are lined up against a white wall in a professional kitchen setting.
